title: Flood Insurance Escrow Taken from a New HECM Scheduled Payment
content:
**Escrow rule.** Added to the withholdings from a new Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) scheduled payment is a flood insurance escrow that builds, a twelfth at a time, the flood renewal falling due a year after the next one:

- a flood insurance premium advanced by Cedarline on the loan (one of the borrower's Property Charge Advance Repayment advances) on a payment date after the same day of the month twelve calendar months before the handling date: the total of the flood insurance premiums advanced in that window, divided by 12;
- none in that window, but a set-aside on the loan (Set-Aside Accounts) depleted with an annual flood premium above 0.00: that annual flood premium, divided by 12;
- otherwise nothing.

**Cases (hypothetical).**

| Flood advanced in the window | Depleted set-aside annual flood premium | Escrow |
|---|---|---|
| 600.00 | any | 50.00 |
| none | 900.00 | 75.00 |
| none | 0.00 | nothing |
| none | no depleted set-aside | nothing |
